title: Rory and the Moonlit Meadow
verses:
The stars started winking high up in the sky,
While Nia flew softly to guide them along.
Sweet Psittaco chirped as he floated on by,
And hummed to the forest a nighttime good-song.

Big Benny walked slow where the moss was so deep,
While Ricky stepped onward with steady, calm grace.
They knew that the valley was falling asleep,
And searched for a quiet and shadowy place.

Kind Rory walked softly with Tilly beside,
Their footsteps were gentle and slow on the ground.
The sleepy silver moon was a shimmering guide,
To where a soft hillock of blossoms was found.

Sweet Tilly stretched out on a carpet of green,
And Psittaco nested in leaves for his rest.
The loveliest meadow that ever was seen,
Tucked safely away in a velvet-soft nest.

Big Benny leaned back with a comforted sigh,
While Ricky tucked down with his chin on his paw.
Above them the clouds floated quietly by,
In wonder and magic and sleepy-eyed awe.

Brave Rory yawned wide as he curled in a ring,
While Nia tucked wings on a branch in the height.
The crickets sang low as they started to sing,
To bid all the dinos a peaceful goodnight.
